description: This file defines the QueueId struct, which serves as an identifier for durable queues within the Orleans streaming extension framework. It includes properties and methods for creating, comparing, and formatting queue identifiers, along with serialization attributes.

classes.name: QueueId
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a unique identifier for a durable queue in Orleans streaming extensions, supporting comparison, equality, and string formatting.

methods.name: GetQueueId
methods.description: Static method to create a new QueueId instance with specified queue name, id, and hash.

methods.name: GetStringNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the queue name prefix string.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns the cached hash code for the queue.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether the QueueId is the default (uninitialized) instance.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this QueueId with another for ordering.

methods.name: Equals (override)
methods.description: Checks equality with an object, if it is a QueueId.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the QueueId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the QueueId.

methods.name: ToStringWithHashCode
methods.description: Returns a string including the hash code.
